senses.gloss: Smooth, even, aligned; not sticking out.
A recently married person.
The name of a place; a word or phrase which indicates a particular location or region.
(In) no way, (in) no manner; not at all.
day of the week, excluding weekends
On weekdays.
Quickly, with great speed; within a short time .
Moving with speed, rapidity or swiftness, or capable of doing so; rapid; fast.
Of the period following a war.
A service request, used to track complaints or requests that an issue be handled.
A coursebook, a formal manual of instruction in a specific subject, especially one for use in schools or colleges.
A fear, antipathy, or hatred of strangers or foreigners.

A long-term respiratory condition, in which the airways may unexpectedly and suddenly narrow, often in response to an allergen, cold air, exercise, or emotional stress. Symptoms include wheezing, shortness of breath, chest tightness, and coughing.
Difficult or laboured breathing.
Data fed into a process with the intention of it shaping or affecting the output of that process.
Approximately, about, around (typically in relation to time)
The treatment of those in need (especially as a profession).
Medical care for an illness or injury.
Any treatment or cure.
treatment of disease
A method, device or medication that restores good health.
To make a solemn promise (to do something).
To drive or campaign ardently for (an effort, project, etc.); to direct.
Observant of tradition; attached to old customs; old-fashioned.
Criticism of oneself.
Hidden, isolated, remote.
Chiefly followed by away: to spend (time) without haste or purpose.
written message — see also missive
A reliable, definitive source of information on a subject.
A person with extensive knowledge or ability in a given subject.
Someone who is an expert in, or devoted to, some specific branch of study or research.
An expert in a particular field, especially as called upon to provide comment or opinion in the media; a commentator, a critic.
A specialist in a given field whose opinion is highly valued, especially in one of the fine arts or in matters of taste.
An expert in a given field; also, a person who is interested in and knowledgeable about a particular activity or thing; an aficionado.
A button or stud used to hold a sleeve cuff together.
An alcoholic drink fermented from starch material, commonly barley malt; often with hops or some other substance (like gruit) to impart a bitter flavor.
A low or mostly-flat sculpture which is carved into a wall, or is in the form of a tile mounted flat to a wall, rather than a fully three-dimensional, free-standing figure.
Information, often secret, about an enemy or about hostile activities.
A person who is fond of something or someone, especially an admirer of a performer or aficionado of a sport.
Someone who is devoted to a particular pursuit etc.

Any (typically wooden) musical instrument that produces sound by the player blowing into it, through a reed, or across an opening. Woodwind instruments include the recorder, flute, piccolo, clarinet, oboe, cor anglais and bassoon.
To fail to see the difference; to mix up; to confuse right and wrong.
Something invented.
In a vague manner.
Any of various edible fungi, of the genus Tuber, that grow in the soil in southern Europe; the earthnut.
Of or relating to theory; abstract; not empirical.
Of or pertaining to a vocation.
A binary digit, generally represented as a 1 or 0.
A small parasitic wingless insect of the order Psocodea.
A box, usually made of metal, in which valuables can be locked for safekeeping.
gymnastic equipment
A box, now usually a large strong box with a secure convex lid.
supermarket checkout position
A strong chest or box used for keeping money or valuables safe.

Understanding retained in the mind, from experience, reasoning and imagination; a generalization (generic, basic form), or abstraction (mental impression), of a particular set of instances or occurrences (specific, though different, recorded manifestations of the concept).
Mental apprehension of whatever may be known, thought, or imagined; idea, concept.
The highest rank of noncommissioned officer in some non-naval military forces and police.
The act of citing a passage from a text, or from another person, using the exact words of the original text or speech and giving credit to the original by referencing.
An evil supernatural being.
A colourless non-aged alcoholic liquor made by distilling fermented grains such as barley, corn, oats or rye with juniper berries; the base for many cocktails.
A jinn, a being descended from the jann, normally invisible to the human eye, but who may also appear in animal or human form.

A human-like spiritual or immaterial being, as opposed to al-ins (people), often invisible but able to manifest in form and also inhabit people or animals; origin of the genie of Western literature, film etc.
Any plant of the genus Nicotiana.
A container used to carry and dispense water for plants (a watering can).
A device for removing the moisture content from air
Completely, fully.
Pleasantly; satisfactorily.

Any of various card games in which, following each of one or more rounds of dealing or revealing cards, the players in sequence make tactical bets or drop out, the bets forming a pool to be taken either by the sole remaining player or, after all rounds and bets have been completed, by those remaining players who hold a superior hand according to a standard ranking of hand values for the game.
Needing to drink water or any liquid that can supply water.
Dry, arid, lacking water.
In the recent past
The quality that renders something desirable or valuable; worth.
see-through, clear
Clear, lucid, or transparent.
A person who retails groceries (foodstuffs and household items) from a grocery.
To contemplate; to keep the mind fixed upon something; to study.
political conservative
Countries or lands abroad.
The act or process of dividing anything.
A part of something that has been divided.
A room, or section, or chamber, typically within a vehicle.
Ingridents used in this type of sandwich:
agent noun of track
Having a beard; involving a beard.
A way of thinking; an attitude or opinion, especially a habitual one.
Someone or something that reminds.
Lacking a permanent place of residence.
A wandering homeless person, especially (historical) one illegally travelling by rail or (derogatory) a penniless, unemployed bum.
To stretch out, open out (a material etc.) so that it more fully covers a given area of space.
To spread (a substance, especially one that colours or is dirty) across a surface by rubbing.
To (cause to) separate and go in different directions; to disperse.
to spread or disseminate
To sow and scatter principles, ideas, opinions, etc, or concrete things, for growth and propagation, like seeds.
To make public or known; to communicate to the public; to tell (information, especially a secret) so that it may become generally known.
Any of several plants of the genus Lens, especially Lens culinaris, from southwest Asia, that have edible, lens-shaped seeds within flattened pods.
A gland near the stomach which secretes a fluid into the duodenum to assist with food digestion.
A very small piece of matter, a fragment; especially, the smallest possible part of something.
Any one of the components of a computer application's graphical user interface, such as a Cancel button or text input box that a user interacts with.
A small particle; a speck.
A type of thin linen or cotton fabric tightly woven of fine threads. (Traditionally expensive and luxurious in centuries past.)
A lengthy speech of reproval.
conflict involving organized use of arms
A general action, fight, or encounter, in which all the divisions of an army are or may be engaged; a combat, an engagement.
A battle, a fight (often one in which weapons are used).
Quick and light in movement or action.
Agile; flexible; able to move fluidly and gracefully.
A mechanical device with evenly-shaped blades that turn on a shaft to push against air or water, especially one used to propel an aircraft or boat.
A formation, usually made up of two or three brigades.
ten thousand — see also ten thousand
An Iranian coin or value of 10 rials.
Characteristic of an expert.
Appearing expensive or sophisticated.
During or throughout the night, especially during the evening or night just past.
A buffer in memory where the user can store data temporarily while transferring it from one place within an application to another or between applications.
That deserves, evokes or can be given pity; pitiful.
In a deplorable state.
Monarchical government based on a claim of succession to the Islamic State of Muhammad, ruled by a caliph.
Artwork.
The skilled practice of a practical occupation.

A branch of skilled work or trade, especially one requiring manual dexterity or artistic skill, but sometimes applied equally to any business, calling or profession; the skilled practice of a practical occupation .
A trade requiring skill of hand; manual occupation; handcraft.
A temporary state of custody or confinement.
One held prisoner.
A person convicted of a crime by a judicial body.
The person or thing at fault for a problem or crime.
The process of writing such comment or commentary.
open sore
A sexually immoral woman.
move gently back and forth
To move (an object) backward and forward; to wave.
To rock (a baby to sleep).
To play truant from school.
somebody who runs, who moves at a fast pace
Any of several green citrus fruit, somewhat smaller and sharper-tasting than a lemon.
To feel displeasure or hatred towards (someone) for their good fortune or possessions.
Disliked; odious; reviled.
Worthy of, or causing, abhorrence, as a thing of evil omen; odious in the utmost degree; very hateful; detestable; loathsome; execrable.
Without scruples; immoral.
Not conscionable; unscrupulous and lacking principles or conscience.
Lacking a conscience; unscrupulous or ruthless.
sequence of events
The natural or man-made deeper course through a reef, bar, bay, or any shallow body of water.
A tubular channel within the body or within a plant.
The path where a river runs, or where a river once ran; the bottom earthen part of a river, not including the riverbanks.
Any channel, either natural or artificial, through which water flows.
Therapy that uses physical techniques such as massage, ultrasound, heat, and exercise.
A European herb (Apium graveolens) of the carrot family.
Not clear; unfocused.
not transparent; not clear
Pertaining to an enigma.
To disgrace, or bring shame upon.
To adjust (a musical instrument) so that it produces the correct pitches.
To walk lame, or unevenly.
To signify; to denote.
A substance, such as glycol, used to lower the freezing point of water.

A process of programmed cell death by which cells undergo an ordered sequence of events which leads to death of the cell, as occurs during growth and development of the organism, as a part of normal cell aging, or as a response to cellular injury.
To regard as arising from a specified cause or source.
To resist or become defiant toward an authority.
Of a wind, blowing from the west; westerly.
Of, pertaining to, or situated in, the occident, or west; western.

A person who buys and sells shares (stock) on a stock exchange on behalf of clients. May also provide investment advice and/or company information, depending on the level of service offered (or chosen by the client).
The substance extracted by distilling.
Any activity undertaken to renew, revamp, update, or improve the appearance of something.
A type of knot with two loops, used to tie together two cords such as shoelaces or apron strings, and frequently used as decoration, such as in gift-wrapping.
An artwork made by applying water-based pigment to wet or fresh lime mortar or plaster.
An absorbent cloth used for cleaning and polishing, formerly made of chamois leather.
A hard wood taken from the birch tree, typically used to make furniture.
The open admittance of having done something (especially something bad).

A therapeutic technique to relieve tension by reestablishing the association of an emotion with the memory or idea of the event that first caused it, and then eliminating it by complete expression (called the abreaction).
The seizure of geographical area to extract its natural resources or exploit the labor of the indigenous peoples to remotely benefit a distant country.
Fit for use or consumption, in accordance with Jewish law (especially relating to food).
Comprising soft cartilage rather than bone.
Any distinctive identifying uniform worn by a group, such as the uniform worn by chauffeurs and male servants.
publication that explains the meanings of an ordered list of words
Any material used to cover the top layer of soil to protect, insulate, or decorate it, or to discourage weeds or retain moisture.
To prepare something by mixing various ingredients, especially to prepare food for cooking.
The state of being bored.
The theory that a nation must always have a positive balance of trade, in the manner that a merchant would operate a shop. Typically this model presupposes protectionism.
A sentence, phrase, or word, forming part of an heraldic achievement.
something liable to more than one interpretation

A mental disorder, less severe than psychosis, marked by anxiety or fear which differ from normal measures by their intensity, which disorder results from a failure to compromise or properly adjust during the developmental stages of life, between normal human instinctual impulses and the demands of human society.
To keep repeating a particular sound involuntarily during speech.
Any natural satellite of a planet.
A moon or other smaller body orbiting a larger one.
One who brings messages.
A person who delivers messages.
The decomposition of a material or compound due to heat, in the absence of oxygen or other reagents.
An item of jewellery designed to be fitted through a piercing (noun sense 2).
Persuasive flattery or kind speech; smooth, wheedling talk.
Blood, especially that from a wound when thickened due to exposure to the air.
Any of the several species of plant in the genus Taraxacum, characterised by yellow flower heads and notched, broad-ended leaves, especially the common dandelion (Taraxacum officinale).
A large medical facility, usually in a building with multiple floors, where seriously ill or injured patients are given extensive medical or surgical treatment.
The act of sedating, especially by use of sedatives.
A material with binder and aggregate that is used to coat interior walls or to make interior mouldings.
organic chemistry sense
To be a good reason behind a normally-unacceptable action; to warrant.

Ellipsis of thymus gland (“A ductless gland, consisting mainly of lymphatic tissue, located behind the top of the breastbone. It is most active during puberty, after which it shrinks in size. It plays an important role in the development of the immune system and produces lymphocytes.”).
A place where the bodies of dead people are cremated.
Great dishonor, shame, or humiliation.
To belong to or be connected as a part, adjunct, attribute, or accessory.
To strike repeatedly with a hammer, some other implement, the fist, etc.
Of, relating to, or involving multiple languages.
Of a person: speaking, or versed in, many languages; multilingual.
To (try to) follow or contact someone constantly, often resulting in harassment.ᵂᵖ
Occurring once every quarter year (three months); taking place quarter-yearly.
